rationale.agent-scope-drift: Step-bound rules detect and constrain agents that skip persistent intent.
rationale.ai-review: Coding agents supply probabilistic code evidence claiming each rule is satisfied.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Testable rules require executable unit-test evidence before step completion.
rationale.remediation-gating: Failed proof gates halt progress while agents autonomously correct omissions.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Users approve plans, tier enforcement, pause agents, and block unacceptable changes.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Rule-linked code evidence and test results support human verification.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent plans, proofs, notes, and histories create a human audit trail.
rationale.survey-input: Study reports enforcement preferences, trust shifts, and intended everyday use.
rationale.framework: Enrich-Enforce-Evolve is presented as a reusable coding-workflow architecture.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented Zoro’s interface and agent-agnostic CLI.
rationale.agentic: Agents execute multi-step plans and deliver repository-scale changes at gates.
rationale.steering: Plan enrichment and evolving rules substantively reshape generation context.
rationale.risk-quality: System mitigates rule violations affecting code and process quality.
rationale.risk-overreliance: User study evaluates evidence-based trust and reduced manual supervision.
rationale.method-self-report: Interviews, think-aloud sessions, and reflections supply human reports.
rationale.method-experiment: Participants complete structured tasks using the built system.
rationale.method-field-study: Several participants used personal repositories for real intended work.
